messages:
Aisha: quick follow-up to the gateway streaming discussion. sketched a tiny "termination-hint" trailer we could expect from upstreams so frontdoor can make smarter resume/telemetry choices. sharing sketch + tradeoffs. thoughts?

Tom: drop the sketch please. concise pls.

Aisha: sketch below. idea: final trailer (<=2KB) with a couple of compact fields: `final_offset`, `resume_token`, `resume_ttl_secs`, `effects_idempotent=bool`, `obs_tags`. intended as advisory only.

Aisha: ```
trailer: final_offset=2410; resume_token="b64:Hk9..."; resume_ttl_secs=300; effects_idempotent=false; obs_tags=model=v2,route=shortgen
```

Priya: resume_token + TTL = nice. we should define token format: base64(seq||snap_id||hmac). HMAC keyed per-tenant to avoid cross-tenant reuse.

Tom: agree on tenant MAC. also, how do we prevent replay? sequence + TTL helps. recommend including token issue timestamp too.

Liz (sre): operational concerns: trailers aren't reliably emitted if client disconnects early. can't depend on them for correctness. we need a fallback: periodic lightweight snapshots on upstream (route opt-in) or server-side minibuffers.

Aisha: yep, plan is opt-in per route: `resume_enabled=true` in route config. only then will upstream snapshot or expect trailer. keeps memory cost bounded.

Priya: snapshots are heavier. suggest snapshot frequency tied to route SLOs and expected message size. also expose a quota so tenants can't abuse snapshot retention.

Tom: implementation in proxy: add a small trailer-collector stage. collector only examines last N bytes (e.g., 2KB) for trailer delimiter and parses compact k=v pairs. avoids buffering entire response.

Liz (sre): perf ask: measure added p50/p95/p99 latency and CPU overhead for the collector under 50k req/s traffic with mix of small+large streams. also track extra memory pressure.

Aisha: will run microbench. rollout plan: (1) collector prototype in runtime, (2) route opt-in flag, (3) resume_token -> trace/span tag, (4) metrics: resume_triggered, resume_verified_success, resume_token_ttl_expired, resume_missing_trailer.

Priya: security: verification failure should be treated as possible tamper. frontdoor should reject resume attempts and fallback to non-resumable flow. log as security event and surface alert for repeated failures.

Tom: what about side-effects safety? upstreams rarely know for sure if side-effects occurred. make `effects_idempotent` advisory. default unknown => no automatic hedging or retries.

Liz (sre): ops runbook: when resume verification fails, downgrade to non-resume, tag trace with `resume:fail` and emit `security.resume.mismatch` metric. if tenant sees many mismatches, escalate to support.

Aisha: extra fields we should consider: `resume_reason` enum (client_abort|upstream_abort|network_error) helps SLO/backfill analysis. keep trailer tiny though. maybe only include on resume-enabled routes or sampled flows.

Priya: agreed on enum. also include a compact `snapshot_id` so upstreams can reference stored checkpoints when trailer absent.

Tom: rollout safety: feature gated behind route config + canary deploy. add a `collector.enabled` flag in runtime so ops can flip it without code change.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: edge/runtime/trailer-collector -> canary 3 nodes

Aisha: thanks. i'll prototype collector with both HTTP/1 chunked and HTTP/2 trailer handling, and measure perf. will post numbers and updated schema (token format, TTL, resume_reasons) early next week. :thumbsup:

Liz (sre): add a dashboard: resume success rate, resume latency, resume_rejects_by_reason. also an alert when resume_success_rate < 90% for a route.

Tom: nit: ensure token length < 64 bytes to avoid header/trailer bloat. base64 + small HMAC fits.

Priya: one more thing: document rotation for HMAC keys and how to handle tokens issued with old keys (allow grace window or include key_id in token).

Aisha: good call. will add `key_id` into token payload and document rotation/expiry behavior. thanks all.
